description: Repo-side inputs whose changes alter the office2 security-monitor baselines. When a commit modifies any matching path, the rebaseline procedure in security-baseline-ops.md should be triggered after the change deploys, otherwise the daily audit will alert as drift. Consumed by tooling/scripts/check_audited_surface_drift.py (CI soft-reminder) and referenced by docs/design/architecture/change-control.md + spec-kitty charter quality gates.

audited_surfaces.description: OpenClaw agent workspace files. The 5-min agent-prompt-sync timer (#567) copies these to /data/services/openclaw/<workspace>/. NOTE (gap #621, confirmed finalize-inbox-file-01KW8MSQ #325): audit.sh hashes only openclaw.json into openclaw-config.txt — it does NOT hash deployed AGENTS.md or other agent workspace files. Agent prompts are an unmonitored audited surface; no baseline is written when they change, so no rebaseline is required or possible for AGENTS.md edits.
OpenClaw runtime config (openclaw.json) is deployed to /home/claude/.openclaw/. The security audit fingerprints openclaw-config.txt from the deployed copy.
audited_surfaces.deploy_path: manual (openclaw config edits land on office2 via direct edit or deploy script)

audited_surfaces.description: Systemd user units and drop-ins deployed to ~/.config/systemd/user/ on office2. The audit hashes the enabled-services / systemd-user-units / systemd-user-dropins baselines. Patterns cover the scripts/office2/ conventional location, scripts/openclaw/*.service.d/ drop-ins (#656 PYTHONPATH guardrail), and scripts/openclaw/deploy/*.{service,timer} — the agent-prompt-sync (#567) and agent-skill-sync (#775) deploy-pipeline units live there, not under scripts/office2/. #1065 adds scripts/openclaw/*.service (openclaw-gateway), scripts/sync/systemd/ (felix-vikunja-sync) and scripts/deploy/felix-deployer/ (the deployer's own units): all three deploy into ~/.config/systemd/user, whose contents audit.sh hashes. tests/deploy/test_audited_surface_unit_coverage.py fails on any tracked unit file outside these patterns that is not listed in system_scope_units. NOTE: a pattern only helps a deploy whose OWN commit range changes the file; a deploy that installs files changed earlier is covered when it installs them through scripts/deploy/lib/userunits.py, which reports what it installed; felix-deployer maps a reported file to this surface's baselines only if its destination lies under host_paths (#1072). Other installers still declare expected_baselines (docs/runbooks/deployment.md).
Top-level Python dependency manifests. Changes deploy via `pip install -r requirements.txt` on office2 and affect pip-packages.txt baseline + pth-files.txt for any new .pth-emitting packages.
audited_surfaces.deploy_path: operator runs pip install on office2

audited_surfaces.description: Docker Compose stacks + Dockerfiles. Changes affect docker-images.txt baseline after `docker compose pull` or rebuild on office2.
audited_surfaces.deploy_path: operator runs docker compose pull/up on office2

audited_surfaces.description: Repo-side SSH key material. Most authorized_keys updates are operator-driven outside the repo; included here so any future committed key source is caught.

Pull-based deploy pipeline (#136 / pull-based-deploy-pipeline-01KTYQQS). The felix-deployer applier on office2 enumerates deploys/queued/<name>.yaml manifests every 5 minutes and routes them through scripts/deploy/lib/. Manifest schema or library API changes can affect every downstream deploy, so both surfaces need a rebaseline if their fingerprints contribute to any baseline.
audited_surfaces.rationale: Deploy script and manifest changes can affect every deployed service; rebaseline required on every change.

system_scope_units.reason: System-scope unit (/etc/systemd/system, sudo-installed). audit.sh does not fingerprint system unit contents directly (#1073); it records only the names of enabled system services (enabled-services.txt). A content-only edit therefore drifts no baseline. Effects can still drift one (enabling a new name drifts enabled-services.txt; a changed ExecStart that alters containers or ports can drift docker-images.txt or listening-ports.txt), and a deploy with such an effect must declare expected_baselines. Not passed to the matcher: listing it here never creates a pending token (#1065).
System-scope unit (/etc/systemd/system, sudo-installed); same reasoning and the same expected_baselines caveat as vikunja.service (#1065).
